integrations_webhooks_intro: Webhooks send an HTTPS request to your server whenever something happens in this workspace, such as a post going out or a channel needing to reconnect.
integrations_webhooks_url_hint: An https address on the standard port, for example https://example.com/hooks.
integrations_webhooks_url_invalid: Use an https address on the standard port, with a host name and no user name or password.
integrations_webhooks_limit: This workspace has as many endpoints as it can have. Delete one before you add another.
integrations_webhooks_failing: This endpoint was turned off because its deliveries kept failing. Fix the receiving server, then turn it back on.
integrations_webhooks_test_sent: Test event queued. It goes out within a minute.
integrations_webhooks_test_limit: You've sent too many test events to this endpoint. Try again in an hour.
integrations_webhooks_test_disabled: Turn the endpoint on before you send a test.

match.countPlural=one: You get a new secret. For the next {count} hour, deliveries carry signatures from both secrets, so your server keeps accepting them while you switch over.
match.countPlural=*: You get a new secret. For the next {count} hours, deliveries carry signatures from both secrets, so your server keeps accepting them while you switch over.

integrations_webhooks_delete_body: Deliveries still waiting for it are dropped. This can't be undone.
integrations_webhooks_secret_once: Copy this secret now. You won't see it again.
integrations_webhooks_secret_use: Your server uses it to check the webhook-signature header of every delivery.
integrations_webhooks_secret_previous: The previous secret keeps working until {time}.
integrations_webhooks_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the secret and copy it yourself.
integrations_webhooks_event_destination_: Waiting to be posted by hand
integrations_webhooks_event_post_complet: Post finished on all its channels
integrations_api_keys_intro: API keys let your own scripts and tools use the Kronaut API for this workspace. A key can never approve posts, connect channels or change settings.
integrations_api_keys_name_hint: So you can tell your keys apart, for example the name of the tool that uses it.
integrations_api_keys_name_invalid: Give the key a name of 1 to {max} characters.
integrations_api_keys_scopes_hint: A key never gets more than your own role allows.
integrations_api_keys_scopes_invalid: One of the chosen permissions can't be given to an API key. Reload the page and choose again.
integrations_api_keys_access_restricted: Only the brands and channels I choose
integrations_api_keys_access_empty: Nothing is chosen yet, so this key would reach no brand and no channel.
integrations_api_keys_access_invalid: One of the chosen brands or channels no longer exists. Reload the page and choose again.
integrations_api_keys_access_not_restric: Brands and channels apply only to a key with restricted access.
integrations_api_keys_expiry_hint: The key stops working at the end of this day in your time zone. Leave it empty for a key that doesn't expire.
integrations_api_keys_expiry_in_past: Choose a day in the future.
integrations_api_keys_rate_limit_hint: From 1 to {max}. Leave it empty for the default of {count}.
integrations_api_keys_rate_limit_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
integrations_api_keys_token_once: Copy this key now. You won't see it again.
integrations_api_keys_token_use: Send it with every request in this header:
integrations_api_keys_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it yourself.
integrations_api_keys_revoke_body: Tools that use it stop working with their next request. This can't be undone.
integrations_read_only: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
